items.html: And because Malchut took one complete joint, it was therefore made a complete Partzuf, afterward, in the secret of the Nukva of ZA, as is known. But the rest of the joints, each one had to bring out two phases, as mentioned, for from the middle joint of Netzah were made Hesed and Netzah of ZA, and likewise in the rest. Also in this you will understand what is said in the Tikunim, that he is in Netzah and she is in Hod. And as we explained in the morning prayer of the weekdays, that ZA descends into Netzah, and the Malchut ascends into Hod. And the reason is understood with what was mentioned. Also you will understand the matter of the tower flying in the air, mentioned in the words of our sages, may their memory be blessed (Sanhedrin 106b, and in the Mishnah Ohalot, chapter 4, mishnah 1), and it is the phase of the Yesod of AA, which remained in the Bina of ZA.
